Email signatures

Five options for Nicole Pezza. Each one has a small looping animation. Press "Copy" on the one you like, then paste it into Gmail.

How to install in Gmail

  1. Press Copy this signature on your favourite above.
  2. In Gmail, open the gear icon, then See all settings.
  3. Scroll to Signature, press Create new, name it "Pezza Media" and paste (Cmd+V) into the box.
  4. Under Signature defaults, pick it for new emails and reply/forward.
  5. Scroll to the bottom and press Save changes.
